components.name: Primary Button

components.html: <button class="ds-btn-primary">View My Work <svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path d="M5 12h14M12 5l7 7-7 7"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; background: #2563eb; color: #ffffff; padding: 14px 24px; border-radius: 12px; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; border: none; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(37,99,235,0.3); transition: background 0.2s, transform 0.2s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #3b82f6; transform: translateY(-2px); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Secondary action button with translucent glass effect.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05); color: #ffffff; padding: 14px 24px; border-radius: 12px; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15); backdrop-filter: blur(12px); cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 0.2s, background 0.2s; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color: rgba(34, 211, 238, 0.3); background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1); }

narrative.overview: "The Obsidian Terminal" evokes a mission-critical computational workbench—quiet, dark, deeply engineered, and illuminated by precise electronic telemetry signals. Rather than loud showmanship or excessive ornamentation, the system relies on deep obsidian black depth (#050816), razor-sharp typography, and tactical bursts of vibrant cyan (#22d3ee) and electric blue (#2563eb). Surfaces feel monolithic, grounded, and physical. Cards and containers reject unstable 3D rotations or playful perspective wobbles; instead, they maintain rock-solid planar integrity while responding with disciplined micro-interactions: illuminated border gradients on hover, hairline dividers, ambient spotlight tracking, and animated status pulses.
keyCharacteristics: Deep obsidian backdrop with low-noise radial ambient lighting and technical vector grids.
High-contrast hierarchy: bright white headings paired with technical monospace labels and muted slate body copy.
Controlled cyan luminescence acting strictly as targeted focal signals.
Solid, non-tilting planar surfaces with subtle glassmorphic backdrop-blur overlays.

rules.name: The Ten Percent Signal Rule
rules.body: Signal cyan (#22d3ee) must occupy no more than 10% of any given viewport. Its rarity gives it high visual priority; overuse dilutes technical impact.

rules.name: The Functional Color Rule
rules.body: Emerald green is strictly reserved for verified statuses and real-time availability. It is never used for decorative aesthetic accents.

rules.name: The Monospace Discipline Rule
rules.body: All metadata, technical tags, categories, credential IDs, and status indicators must be rendered in JetBrains Mono with uppercase tracking.

rules.name: The Zero-Tilt Invariant
rules.body: Cards must remain planar and level under cursor motion. Motion is expressed through border glow transitions, background spotlight gradients, and thumbnail scales, never geometric distortion.

dos: Do maintain stable, planar cards with zero 3D tilt or rotation when hovering.
Do restrict signal cyan (#22d3ee) to targeted focal highlights and key metadata.
Do format technical categories, credentials, and tags in JetBrains Mono with uppercase tracking.
Do ensure all external links have accessible labels and open securely in new tabs (rel="noreferrer").
Do preserve fast static single-page performance without introducing heavyweight database dependencies.
donts: Don't apply 3D transform perspectives (rotateX, rotateY, perspective) to content cards.
Don't flood broad background panels with saturated cyan or blue gradients.
Don't use decorative generic stock photos; use real project captures and diagrams.
Don't use low-contrast text that violates WCAG AA standards against obsidian backgrounds.
Don't hide critical portfolio navigation or project links behind multi-click carousels.
